    if direction == 'U':
        return x - 1, y
    elif direction == 'D':
        return x + 1, y
    elif direction == 'L':
        return x, y - 1
    elif direction == 'R':
        return x, y + 1

def turn_clockwise(direction, times):
    directions = ['U', 'R', 'D', 'L']
    index = directions.index(direction)
    new_index = (index + times) % 4
